import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

data = """amount,is_fraud,transaction_type,hour_of_day
115.02,0,refund,22
44.37,0,payment,5
144.25,0,transfer,21
536.22,0,payment,17
38.43,0,payment,5"""

df = pd.read_csv(pd.compat.StringIO(data))

plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
sns.scatterplot(x='hour_of_day', y='amount', hue='transaction_type', data=df, s=100, alpha=0.7)
plt.title('Transaction Amounts by Hour of Day and Type')
plt.xlabel('Hour of Day')
plt.ylabel('Transaction Amount')
plt.grid(True)
plt.savefig('output.png')
plt.close()
